pages.text: The $(thing)Prospector's Hammer$() is a near copy of its pick-y brother, with the notable exception of a smaller range, only searching the 13x13x13 area centered on the clicked block.
pages.title: Prospector's Hammer

pages.text: A mold for the tool head can be $(l:getting_started/pottery)knapped$() from some clay, as shown above, which can be used to $(l:getting_started/finding_ores#casting)cast$() low tier metals.
A $(thing)Prospector's Hammer Head$() can also be $(l:mechanics/anvils#working)smithed$() out of a $(thing)double ingot$() of any tool metal. Craft the head with a stick to make a Prospector's Hammer
